item.title: Using Pinterest and AI to Nail My Design Vision
item.description: In this post, I’ll be breaking down how I translated my initial ideas into final design sketches using Pinterest, a visual search platform, and generative AI, specifically the text-to-image feature in Microsoft Designer. Together, these tools helped me both explore and clarify my aesthetic and generate design references far beyond what I could imagine on my own.
